market_question: Will Jordan Bardella win the 2027 French presidential election?
reasoning: Jordan Bardella's chance to win the 2027 French presidential election is heavily contingent on first securing the National Rally nomination over Marine Le Pen, who polls show is preferred by a majority of party supporters. Even if nominated, current runoff polling consistently shows Bardella losing to likely center-right or centrist opponents by 4–8 points. Compounding these factors suggests a true probability around 5%, far below the market-implied 22.5%.
evidence_points: Odoxa (March 2025) found 63% of RN symphathizers prefer Le Pen as the party's 2027 candidate, vs 34% for Bardella.
Cluster17 (April 2025) second-round poll: Bardella loses to Philippe 46%-54%, and Ifop (March 2025) shows similar deficits against Attal and Darmanin.
In the 2022 runoff, Marine Le Pen (a more established figure) only achieved 41.5%, and without Macron in 2027, centrist consolidation still poses a high barrier for a less experienced Bardella.
sources_consulted: Odoxa survey (March 2025) on RN candidate preference
